name: Ferienpark Terrassencamping Süd-See
beschreibung: The Ferienpark Terrassencamping Süd-See is located directly on the shore of Walchsee in the Tiroler Kaisertal. The terraced complex extends over gently sloping terrain with a view of the surrounding Kaiserberge. Pitches for motorhomes and tents are partly equipped with private sanitary cabins. A private bathing bay offers direct access to the lake. The offerings include a restaurant, a playground, and a small shop with basic supplies.
